decks.notes: This deck focuses on using ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to quickly reach high amounts of mana and cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. Control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command are used to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also providing value. The deck also includes cards like Kozilek's Return for board control and World Breaker for removal. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with large threats and disrupt their strategy with control elements.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of low-cost spells and creatures to quickly assemble a powerful win condition, in this case, using Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while also ramping up mana with cards like Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention. By efficiently controlling the game and quickly assembling the combo pieces, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can adequately respond.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive play, utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to deal damage quickly. It also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to control the board and keep the pressure on the opponent. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support for the aggressive strategy, while cards like Static Prison and Flooded Strand help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of creatures, removal spells, and disruptive elements, this Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. It also utilizes board wipes like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Return to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck can generate overwhelming advantage through cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble, while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with Bojuka Bog and Sanctum of Ugin. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with large threats and control the game until victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the board state and disrupting your opponent's plans through a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and powerful planeswalkers. With cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, you can disrupt your opponent's plays while generating card advantage. By utilizing efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, you can handle threats efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Eternal Witness for recursion and card advantage, allowing you to outvalue your opponent in the long game.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also controlling the board with cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory. It utilizes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to apply pressure, while also providing card advantage with cards like Thraben Charm and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also has a strong mana base with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of its powerful spells. By combining efficient creatures, burn spells, and control elements, the deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively.

This deck relies on using a variety of creatures to assemble different combinations and synergies in order to gain advantage and disrupt opponents. It utilizes cards like Viscera Seer, Gilded Goose, Cauldron Familiar, and Chord of Calling to toolbox for specific creatures or answers while generating value through sacrificing and recurring creatures. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by utilizing a diverse array of creature abilities and combo potential.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures along with blink effects to control the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, it can repeatedly exile and return creatures to take advantage of their enter the battlefield effects and protect them from removal. With a mix of disruption through Thoughtseize and removal spells, paired with powerful aggressive creatures like Ketramose and Emperor of Bones, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining control of the game.

This Boros Aggro deck is centered around overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures such as Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The versatile creature removal of Goblin Bombardment and control elements like Static Prison help maintain board presence and disrupt opponents. The deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy involves playing powerful low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride, while utilizing cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Static Prison and Boom / Bust to slow down opponents and maintain control of the game. The goal is to apply constant pressure and efficiently close out games before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and various mana ramp spells in order to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt opponent's strategies, while also having access to card draw with Ancient Stirrings and Nulldrifter. Additionally, the deck includes Sowing Mycospawn and Writhing Chrysalis as win conditions by creating a large number of tokens or mutating creatures.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, disruption, and removal spells. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Sink into Stupor, while using cards like Counterspell and Force of Negation to prevent key spells from resolving. The inclusion of creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog adds a threat to the board while utilizing control elements. Overall, the deck looks to maintain control of the game and out-value the opponent through efficient spells and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief, and Eldrazi Temple to ramp up and create a powerful board presence. By combining the synergies of these cards with support from Urza's Saga and Malevolent Rumble, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Emrakul, the Promised End. The inclusion of cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Vexing Bauble adds a disruptive element to the combo strategy, allowing for versatile and unexpected plays in order to secure victory.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also includes control elements such as Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return to deal with opponent's threats while Malevolent Rumble and Sowing Mycospawn help protect your own board. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of fast mana ramp and strong creatures, while also having the means to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counter spells and removal while drawing cards and generating card advantage. The deck aims to control the game by countering threats, removing problematic permanents, and utilizing planeswalkers like Teferi to control the pace of the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Narset to limit the opponent's card draw and Tune the Narrative to manipulate the top of the library. The manabase is designed to support the control elements of the deck while allowing for flexibility in casting spells of different colors.

This deck utilizes Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to quickly bring out powerful threats like Emrakul and Ulamog. Control elements like Chalice of the Void and All Is Dust help disrupt opponents' strategies while Sowing Mycospawn provides additional value. The deck aims to control the game early on and overwhelm opponents with large Eldrazi creatures. The inclusion of cards like Through the Breach and Ugin's Labyrinth allows for explosive plays and can catch opponents off guard. Overall, the deck focuses on ramping into big threats and controlling the board to secure victory.
